subject: Data retention exception - FinPay (post-call follow-up)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finpay.com>, Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention exception - FinPay (post-call follow-up)

Hi Alicia / Jorge —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we discussed
- FinPay needs tighter controls on PII and wants a data retention exception for chat transcripts and debug logs for this integration (priority: 0-retention for PII, shortened retention for non-PII logs).
- You’ll need proof that we can redact PII, a written exception that limits log access, and a schedule for purge timelines.
- FinPay legal will review a formal exception/annex before procurement proceeds.

Our proposed approach
1) We can support configurable retention windows per customer and per data class (PII vs non-PII).
2) For PII we can enforce immediate redaction/purge (0-retention) on request; for operational logs we can propose a 7-30 day window depending on your needs.
3) We’ll provide SOC2 report, architecture diagram for logging pipeline, and an exception template to use as a starting point.

Requested action items
- Alicia / Jorge: confirm whether FinPay requires absolute 0-retention for all chat transcripts, or 0-retention only for transcripts containing PII (we can autodetect and redact).
- FinPay legal: please confirm preferred retention window for non-PII operational logs (7 / 14 / 30 days) and whether audit logs (who accessed what) must be retained longer for compliance.

Next steps
- I’ve attached a short Data_Retention_Options.pdf that outlines how retention tiers work and the controls we can enable.
- If you’d like, Marissa (our security lead) can join the legal review call next week to walk through the exception draft.

Proposed timeline
- Confirm retention targets by Mon 3/13 -> we’ll draft the exception and circulate.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Data_Retention_Options.pdf (pdf)
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@finpay.com>
Cc: FinPay Legal <legal@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 17:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention exception - FinPay (post-call follow-up)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear summary and for the attachment. A couple clarifications from our side: 

1) Priority: FinPay requires 0-retention for any chat transcript or support interaction that contains cardholder data or any PII (name, email, SSN fragments). If content is anonymized and we can validate PII removal, we could consider short-term retention for troubleshooting (7 days max).
2) We still need an audit trail of administrative access (who accessed logs) for 12 months per our internal policy, but that audit trail can be stored in a separate immutable store (hashed identifiers are fine).
3) We will need a redaction proof (how you detect/redact PII) and a formal exception template that our legal team can redline.

Can your team confirm:
- Mechanism for automatic redaction (pattern matching + ML PII classifier) and an SLA for purge after redaction.
- Whether billing/usage metadata must be retained for billing reconciliation - if so, how long will that be stored and is it separable from content logs?

We’d like to get a draft exception in the hands of our legal team this week. I’ve cc’d legal so they can advise on timeline.

Thanks,
Alicia
Director, Product Security | FinPay
Alicia.Gomez@finpay.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention exception - FinPay (internal)

Camila / Rafael —

Good summary. Recommended negotiation posture: give FinPay 0-retention for content that contains PII and offer a 7-day troubleshooting window for non-PII conversational transcripts with strict access controls and per-request audit logs. Keep billing/usage metadata separate and retain for 365 days (necessary for finance).

Notes / commitments we should make in the draft exception:
- Technical controls: automatic PII detection pipeline (regex + ML classifier) + immediate redaction/pseudonymization; redaction events logged to an immutable audit log (hash IDs) for 12 months.
- Access controls: only designated FinPay admins + Redwood infra on-call can request unredacted logs; each access requires an MRA (mutual request approval) and is time-limited (48 hours).
- Retention: PII -> 0 days post-redaction; non-PII transcripts -> default 7 days (can be increased to 14/30 on request), billing metadata -> 365 days.
- Escrow: If FinPay requires, we can provide a snapshot of logs for a defined window under an NDA, but by default we will not store raw PII.

I’ve attached a Retention_Exception_Template.docx that we can pre-fill and send to Alicia + legal. I suggest Rafael review the access control language before we send.

-Marissa
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Retention_Exception_Template.docx (docx)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finpay.com>, FinPay Legal <legal@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention exception - FinPay (proposed draft + next steps)

Hi Alicia / FinPay legal —

Thanks for the quick reply. Per Marissa’s notes we’ve prepared a proposed exception draft and an SLA addendum that reflect the commitments below: 

Summary of commitments (proposed)
- PII: automatic detection + immediate redaction/pseudonymization; raw PII will not be retained (0 days).
- Non-PII conversation transcripts: default retention 7 days; can be configured to 14/30 with mutual agreement.
- Audit/access logs: hashed access records retained for 12 months in an immutable store.
- Billing/usage metadata: retained 365 days for reconciliation; separated from content storage.
- Access policy: access to raw logs by Redwood must be approved by FinPay security; emergency access requires documented approval and is time-limited.

What we’re sending now
- Attached: SLA_and_Retention_Spec.pdf (technical SLA + retention schedule)
- Draft exception/annex uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/retention-exception-FP-3487 (editable doc)
- DocuSign link (proposed signature flow): https://app.docusign.com/retention-exception/FP-3487

Requested next steps
1) FinPay legal: please review the draft in Drive and mark any redlines by EOD Tue 3/14.
2) If acceptable, we’ll route the final annex to DocuSign and target signature by Fri 3/17 so procurement can complete the PO.
3) If you prefer a call to walk through the controls, Marissa and Rafael are available next week - propose Tues 3/14 10am PT or Wed 3/15 2pm PT.

If there are specific technical proofs you want (e.g., a demo of the redaction pipeline or a short recording of the purge operation), we can provide that as a follow-up.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SLA_and_Retention_Spec.pdf (pdf)
